newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates end lower on NCD maturation.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates end lower on NCD maturation.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates closed lower on Friday as the maturation of T$5 billion negotiable certificates of deposit further eased liquidity in the banking system, dealers said.

The overnight interbank rate finished at 5.753 percent against Thursday's 6.027 percent close -- still outside the central bank's 5.00-5.5 percent target zone -- with 30-day commercial paper falling to 5.75-5.85 percent against 6.00.
In the bond market, the 10-year 86/4 bond yield closed at 6.0375 percent against 6.0870-0875.
